en: Die? That's taking it too far...

*sigh*
You don't get it.

That shameless attitude is another reason why
males should be extinct!

Just the fact that you're males is good
enough reason to go extinct!

If you say things like that, you'll never
be able to see eye to eye...
Huh!? I think you got something wrong here!

I don't plan to get along with males! I wish
for the total annihilation of degenerates!

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like having a normal conversation
at this point is out of the question.
<CLT=cltMIND>Damn, this is awkward...

True, this might be a huge deal
for you, Tenko.

Grrrrrr! For a degenerate, you're pretty
sensitive to the feelings of others!
If you get it, then you should destroy yourself!
Ah, no, I don't think I'll do that...
<CLT=cltMIND>I think this conversation went well.

Isn't there some way to do it without
fighting? There must be a peaceful way...
Huuuh? If there is, please tell me.

Well, even if there's such a method,
I don't wanna try it anyway!
<CLT=cltMIND>...Well, actually, I can't think of any.

<CLT=cltMIND>It seems like that didn't
go well...

If you're going to fight...
I'll root for you.

W-Whoa! You've decided to get
rid of yourself!?

So you're gonna destroy your cursed
existence and give this world to girls!?

Ah, no. I was thinking more along the lines
of helping you fight to overcome your hatred.
Overcome my hatred for degenerate males!?

What are you saying!? It's absolutely necessary
to hate males!
God created this unyielding law of nature!

But are you okay with living like that forever?
Running away from your problems?

Grrrr... I'm surprised a degenerate
would ask such a tough question...

Does this mean you have no intention of
eradicating yourself?

Then I'll fight until I create a world without
males!

Shuichi! If you wanna join the girls' side,
then now's the time, got it!?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Sometimes, it's easier
to just say nothing.

<CLT=cltMIND>Good, it seems like
we both had a lot of fun.
